title: The Life a Reward Point Is Given on a Circle Membership
content:
## The life a point is given on a Circle membership

The pool a sweep takes on a Northbeam Circle Membership is measured against the life a point is given, and
that life follows the standing of the membership and the earning occasions standing in the three months ending
on the handling day.

1. Where the membership stands active and an earning occasion stands in the three months ending on the
   handling day, the pool swept is measured against a life of the expiry months of the tier and the active
   member extension of this schedule, 6 months, together.
2. Where the membership does not stand active and no earning occasion stands in the three months ending on
   the handling day, the pool swept is measured against a life of the expiry months of the tier less the
   dormancy reduction of this schedule, 6 months.
3. Where neither of those holds, the pool swept is measured against a life of the expiry months of the tier.

## The life each reading gives, tier by tier

| Tier | Expiry months of the tier | Active and earning recently | Not active and not earning recently | Neither |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 12 | 18 months | 6 months | 12 months |
| Circle Plus Annual | 18 | 24 months | 12 months | 18 months |
| Circle Total Annual | 24 | 30 months | 18 months | 24 months |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 24 | 30 months | 18 months | 24 months |
| Circle Business Pro | 24 | 30 months | 18 months | 24 months |
| Circle Business Elite | 36 | 42 months | 30 months | 36 months |

## Cases on the three readings

A membership standing active on Circle Plus Annual with an earning occasion booked last month is measured
against a life of 24 months, so points earned 23 months ago are not in the pool.

A membership standing lapsed on the same tier with nothing earned in the three months ending on the handling
day is measured against a life of 12 months, so points earned 14 months ago are in the pool.

A membership standing active with nothing earned in those three months, and a membership standing lapsed with
an earning occasion inside them, both fall to the third reading and are measured against the 18 months of that
tier. The longer the life, the smaller the pool, since the pool is the points earned over the whole ledger
less the points earned inside that life.
